$comment: The one data file build.py reads to build the money-minor-units fixture, modelled on docs/case-study-money.md. 'people' are Larder's fourteen engineers; 'scopes' are their fourteen scopes, written into penguin/scopes.json with contracts as path::symbol; 'invariants' and 'examples' become penguin/invariants.json, and an example with a 'sample' is generated by build.py from that sample's spec; 'features' are every feature with its commits in source directories under features/<id>/; a feature with the role 'wave' is one wave of the parallel change, and a commit with 'after' is a running feature's second fix, built on the tagged commit it names; 'promotions' move main to a feature's head; 'plan' is the one-block attempt's merge plan. Commits are built in date order. docs/fixture-money.md describes every field.

base.message:
Base: Larder's fourteen scopes with prices as floats in dollars

Scopes, owners, agent identities and invariants are declared in penguin/.

invariants.statement: Every price is rounded to its currency's minor unit
The card charge equals the cart total
An order's total is the sum of its line totals
A stored order record reads back with the prices it was stored with
A refund never exceeds what was paid for the returned lines
An invoice's total due equals the card charge for the order
Tax is rounded per line item
Each order is taxed at its region's rate
A discount never takes a price below zero
A store's payout plus its fee equals the order total
A store fee rounds half up to the minor unit
A price band includes its lower bound
Daily revenue equals the sum of that day's order totals
Revenue in different currencies is never added together
A receipt shows the amount the customer paid
An order payload carries its total for display and in the minor unit
Opening hours are in the store's local time

sample.$comment: 5,000 recorded US orders, each drawn from the fixed seed with no filtering: one to max_lines lines, each with a price in price_cents and a quantity up to max_quantity, in one of the rates' regions.

commits.message:
Replace float prices with Money(amount_minor, currency)

price() takes an amount in the currency's minor unit and returns Money; total() sums
Money in one currency; display() moves to Money.display(). JPY has no minor unit.

shared/money gains Money and discounted(); orders gains line_total_minor() and
order_total_minor(). No existing function changes, so every caller keeps working.

checkout: total the cart in Money in the cart's currency

cart_total(), charge_amount() and total_line() take the cart's currency. The charge is
the total's amount_minor, so a yen cart is charged at face value.

promotions: stack coupons on Money

From the checkout wave's plan: stacking takes the cart's currency and uses discounted().

tax: compute tax in Money on the order subtotal

The rate is a Decimal and the subtotal is rounded once to the minor unit.

tax: round tax per line item again

the tax on multi-line orders.

invoicing: add the tax in Money

refunds, payouts: return Money

Refunds sum line totals in the order's currency. Store fees round half up in the minor
unit, whatever the shared rounding mode, as the store agreement says.
